output.root_cause: Frontend pods are failing health checks due to timeout errors, with liveness and readiness probes timing out when trying to reach the /_healthz endpoint. One pod is not ready and the service has anomalous behavior. There are also environment configuration issues with the CART_SERVICE_ADDR pointing to port 1 instead of the correct port 7070.
output.action_taken: Patch the CART_SERVICE_ADDR environment variable from 'cartservice:1' to 'cartservice:7070' to fix the service connectivity issue
evidence: get_k8s_state(frontend) shows pod frontend-6965587bf-gl4qg is not ready and health check failures
get_k8s_state(frontend) shows CART_SERVICE_ADDR environment variable is set to 'cartservice:1' instead of the correct port
get_k8s_state(cartservice) shows the service is running on port 7070
get_k8s_state(frontend) shows liveness and readiness probe failures with timeout errors
get_logs(frontend) shows timeout errors including 'failed to get ads: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded'
get_dependency_traces(frontend) shows cartservice as a slow downstream dependency
